title: Virtual Craft
description: A modpack that lets you feel like you are in minecraft.
body:
Virtual Craft is an immersive Minecraft modpack built for VR, but you don't need a headset to enjoy it. Whether you're putting on a headset or sitting at your desk, Virtual Craft adds a more atmospheric feel to Minecraft with smoother performance, stunning visuals, new world generation, and a bunch of quality-of-life improvements that make every part of the game feel polished.

# Features

### VR Optimized Experience

Interactions, movement, terrain, and shaders all meant to be a more enhanced vanilla experience designed to be played in virtual reality. Controls are currently being worked on to be the best general control system I can make.

### Performance

A bunch of performance mods working together to get the best performance out of minecraft without changing how to game works.

### Visuals

Shaders and Resource Packs picked out to make the game look the best it can while still matching the vanilla stile of the game.

### Better World Generation

A few terrain generation and structure mods that enhance the game to make it look, and play better.

# Recent Content Update

It's only the first version, so it was just the modpack

# Current Compatablilities

### Minecraft Versions

26.1.2

### Mod Loader

Fabric

# Upcoming Plans

### Currently Working On

Updating the 26.1.2 version to fix an issue with the hud not working in VR, I'm also changing/removing structure mods to better fit the vanilla theme.

### Minecraft Versions

I'm planning on making versions of this modpack for all the big future updates. Also maybe some older versions, depending on how much is needed to be done.

### Mod Loader

I'm planning on adding Forge, and possible Quilt if enough people ask for it, and I'm able to get enough content to make the full modpack.

## Mods and Resource Packs

None of this would even be possible without all of the Mods and Resource Packs that have been created, so I want to give a big thanks to all of the creaters of the Mods and Resource Packs listed below.
